facts.label: Past progressive e when
facts.sub: Use was/were + verbo-ing para a ação em andamento e when + passado simples para a ação curta: I was walking home when it started to rain.

facts.label: Cena
facts.sub: Use was ou were + verbo-ing para mostrar o que estava acontecendo: I was walking home. They were waiting. É como uma foto do momento passado, com a ação ainda em andamento.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para a ação curta que interrompe: I was walking when it started to rain. A ação longa fica no past progressive e a ação curta fica no passado simples.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past progressive uses was or were + -ing.
When often comes before a short action.
items.why: Yes: when it started to rain.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

answers: The past progressive uses was or were + -ing. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was walk home”. → Falso (We say I was walking.)
When often comes before a short action. → Verdadeiro (Yes: when it started to rain.)

paragraphs: It is a rainy evening in Cork. Wet streets shine under the lamps. People walk home under umbrellas. Seth sits in his warm kitchen. A knock comes at the door. It is his friend Ben, all wet.
“Hi, Ben! Why were you running in the rain?” says Seth. “I was walking home when it started to rain.” says Ben. “Were you carrying an umbrella?” says Seth.

group: Expressões-chave: Why were you running in the rain? = Por que você estava correndo na chuva?; I was walking home when it started to rain. = Eu estava andando para casa quando começou a chov…; Were you carrying an umbrella? = Você estava levando um guarda-chuva?; No, I wasn’t. = Não.; A man was reading a newspaper. = Um homem estava lendo um jornal.; I was making tea when you knocked. = Eu estava fazendo chá quando você bateu..
Escolha 3 prioritárias para usar o resto da aula.
extra90: Cada aluno usa 2 expressões em uma mini-cena de 20 segundos.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: Was soa “uóz” e were soa “uér”. Na fala rápida, was fica fraco: “uez”.
pages.how: Diga were como “uér”, com o r no fim.
pages.tip: Compare was e were: a vogal muda.

solo: Modele, peça repetição, depois uso livre.
group: Foco: was e were. Diga were como “uér”, com o r no fim.
Coro, depois um a um; ouça sem corrigir tudo.
extra90: Cada aluno grava um áudio de 10 segundos e compara com o modelo.
